title: Biggest memory user and its restart count
description: Two facts in one question: which container uses the most memory (comfyui, 13.1 GiB) and how many times it restarted (7, lifetime). get_collector_data (docker, sort_by mem_usage) gives both in one call; container_inspect works too. Tests multi-field answers from one slice and that the model reports the restart count, not just the memory user, with readable units.

messages.content: Which container uses the most RAM right now, and how many times has it restarted?

judge.rubric: Answers: comfyui, about 13.1 GiB, restarted 7 times. Possibly a half-sentence of context (ollama second). Brief, no raw byte counts, no commands suggested.
